{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Tie-neck blouse, relaxed cut, long sleeves, hip length, cobalt blue (#1F4FBF), satin-finish crepe

Wide-leg trousers, high rise, full length to the ankle bone, camel (#B88A5A), wool-blend twill

Textured blazer, single-breasted, slightly tailored, hip length, charcoal herringbone (#3A3D45), wool tweed

Coat, single-breasted, straight cut, knee length, deep burgundy (#6D1F2F), brushed wool

Loafers, almond toe, low block heel, black (#1C1C1C), polished leather with gold-tone hardware

Belt, slim, cognac (#8B5A2B), smooth leather with a small gold buckle

Structured tote, medium size, cognac (#8B5A2B), grained leather

Fine chain necklace, short length, gold tone (#C9A227), metal

Why this outfit works: The cobalt blouse against warm camel trousers is a confident color pairing that gets you noticed while the silhouette stays office-appropriate. The herringbone blazer adds texture and structure, so the look reads as neat and professional rather than loud. The burgundy coat suits the autumn chill and adds a rich, deliberate accent. Cognac accents on the belt and bag tie the warm tones together, and the polished loafers keep you comfortable through a full day."}
